title: Sajjad Sajjad
body:
Sajjad Sajjad
Wa hussaina!!!
Zindaa'n se madine aakar bhi sajjad lahu rote hi rahe
maa asghar ki suraj ke tale baithi rahi kitne din guzre
Mukhtaar ne ek din di ye khabar, ye kehdo madar e asghar se
maara gaya qatil asghar ka, ab dhup se shehzadi uthiye
sajjad ne aakar maa se kaha, aye amma ab baitho na yaha
ab thanda paani pilo maa, ab saaye me aao amma
<<MINI>>
sajjad, sajjad, sajjad
<<DIVIDER>>
tu khoo'n rona jo chod de..(2)
mai saaye mein aajaungi
<<MINI>>
sajjad, sajjad, sajjad
<<DIVIDER>>
tu rat rona je chad de we, mai bhi tupnu chad jawangi
1. Sajjad zara insaaf te kar, aye hukm na de israar na kar
eho soch ke hai fatwenda jigar, menda ujad gaya hai wasda ghar
nit rowangi hud tup wich mai..(2), wich tupte ee marjawangi
<<MINI>>
sajjad, sajjad, sajjad
<<DIVIDER>>
2. Mai takya e begoro kafan, tup wich baba mazloom tera
nai tup jo uth sakdi bachda, tup band gayi ye maqsoom mera
hid jad tak saawich samere..(2), wich tupte sog manawangi
<<MINI>>
sajjad, sajjad, sajjad
<<DIVIDER>>
3. Maara gaya qatil asghar ka, asghar to nahi milne wala
wo zakhmi gala jalta jhula, nasoor hai mere seene ka
tu dil ko pakadna chod de..(2), mai saaye mein aajaungi
<<MINI>>
sajjad, sajjad, sajjad
<<DIVIDER>>
4. Jo laashe husain te kita mai, wo waada tod nibhana hai
majboor na kar meku puttar meda, meku saaya raas na aanaye
muk jaane o do saamere..(2), jado chawe puttar me jawangi
<<MINI>>
sajjad, sajjad, sajjad
<<DIVIDER>>
5. Haiwa ko bhi zibha hote hue, tu dekh nahi sakta beta
kazzab zabeeho par apne, tujhe dekhke daalte hai parda
ghash kha kar girna chod de..(2), mai saaye mein aajaungi
<<MINI>>
sajjad, sajjad, sajjad
<<DIVIDER>>
6. Nai tup jo uthi jekar mai, tera vi rona nai mukya
aji tay puttar sajjad tera, ankhiyada pani nai sukya
tere wag de athru je thal gae, mai vicha mein wejawangi
<<MINI>>
sajjad, sajjad, sajjad
<<DIVIDER>>
7. Mere waali tum shahid rehna, mazboot abhi tak waada hai
saaye ki taraf jo leke chala, sajjad wo mera laasha hai
zainab mera shana chod de..(2), mai saaye mein aajaungi
<<MINI>>
sajjad, sajjad, sajjad
<<DIVIDER>>
8. Kar dafn rabab ku saina khe, oda pallu me ku khol wakha
sajjad ne khol ke jad takya, gaya zainab de sang wo ghash khaa
pallu wich chola asghar da..(2), naale raakh jhule diya lawangi
<<MINI>>
sajjad, sajjad, sajjad
<<DIVIDER>>
9. Khurshid rehan nadeem deye, nit hasrat dil wich rendiye
un pursa deiye ro roke, rayi tup wich jedi pendiye
likhiye nauhe, padhiye nauhe..(2), hai saanj jado tak sawangi
<<MINI>>
sajjad, sajjad, sajjad
